01 / THE STARTING POINTTHOUGHT BEFORE FORM
A QUESTION I KEEP COMING BACK TO

What if the way it works could be as considered as the way it feels?

A website is often the first conversation someone has with a business. It should give them a reason to stay—and a clear way to move forward.

That’s the space I work in. Between the expressive and the practical. Between an interface that draws you in and a system that carries the work behind it.

DESIGNED INTERFACE STUDY — NOT A PRODUCTION SCREENSHOT01

Scout
by Nayak.

AI SALES WORKSPACEVisit live website ↗

A clearer path from “who should we talk to?” to outreach a founder can actually review.

THE PROBLEM

Prospecting is fragmented. Research, company context and draft messages tend to live in separate places. It’s easy to produce activity without a useful conversation.

THE BUILD

Scout brings prospect research and outreach preparation into a shared workspace. The workflow keeps human review between a generated draft and a sending action.

BEHIND THE INTERFACE

A React frontend connects to a FastAPI backend and Postgres database. A separate worker handles background jobs. Database migrations, deployment runbooks and automated checks support the application beyond its screens.

ReactTypeScriptFastAPIPostgresBackground jobs

Ongoing product development. The live site is available; individual integrations and workflows continue to be validated.

DESIGNED INTERFACE STUDY — NOT A PRODUCTION SCREENSHOT02

Virality
OS.

AI-ASSISTED CONTENT PLATFORMLIVE DEMO CURRENTLY UNAVAILABLE

An exploration of how AI can help creators move from a rough thought to a more deliberate first draft.

THE PROBLEM

A blank page is rarely a shortage of ideas. It’s the work of choosing an angle, adapting it to a platform and finding words that still sound like you.

THE BUILD

Virality OS explores a creator workflow around content ideas, brand voice and AI-assisted drafting. The focus is on helping a person develop an idea, with an interface built around that process.

BEHIND THE INTERFACE

The project uses Next.js and TypeScript, with Tailwind for interface styling and Prisma in the data layer. It brings application structure and AI integrations together in one product codebase.

Next.jsTypeScriptTailwind CSSPrismaAI integration

In development. A verified public demo is not currently available.

I’m Shivansh Nayak.
A developer and founder based in India.

I build across the visible and invisible parts of a product: the screen someone interacts with, the API behind it and the decisions connecting the two.

I’m drawn to work that asks for both imagination and care. The visual idea matters. So do the loading state, the mobile experience and what happens when something goes wrong.
